strings.name: Nandan Nilekani
strings.role: Technology entrepreneur · Infosys co-founder and non-executive chairman
strings.summary: Nilekani began in electrical engineering and software, co-founding Infosys and later becoming its CEO. As founding UIDAI chairman from 2009 to 2014, he led Aadhaar's digital identity program, whose privacy and mandatory uses also prompted controversy. He later supported education and inclusion through EkStep, philanthropy and digital public infrastructure. In 2026 he was appointed to lead an examination-reform taskforce.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founding Infosys and helping build India's digital identity infrastructure connected software, public services and digital inclusion.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.highlights.h1.title: Software and public identity
strings.highlights.h1.text: He moved from Infosys management to Aadhaar, applying large systems to identification within contested privacy and legal boundaries.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Education technology and philanthropy
strings.highlights.h2.text: With Rohini Nilekani and Shankar Maruwada, he developed EkStep's open learning infrastructure.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Leading an exam-reform taskforce
strings.timeline.t1.text: Appointed to study reforms, he proposed question banks and last-minute paper generation in October; proposals were not completed implementation.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Major gift to his alma mater
strings.timeline.t2.text: He announced INR 3.15 billion for IIT Bombay's research, infrastructure and innovation.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Returning as Infosys chairman
strings.timeline.t3.text: He became non-executive chairman, overseeing board governance.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Launching EkStep together
strings.timeline.t4.text: With Rohini and Maruwada, he advanced a nonprofit education project focused on literacy and numeracy.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Contesting a parliamentary seat
strings.timeline.t5.text: He ran for Congress in Bengaluru South but was not elected.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founding chairman of UIDAI
strings.timeline.t6.text: He left Infosys's board to lead the digital identity program, serving until 2014.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Becoming Infosys CEO
strings.timeline.t7.text: He led software services and international business until 2007.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Co-founding Infosys
strings.timeline.t8.text: With Murthy and other partners, he established the software company and helped develop markets and business.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Engineering studies completed
strings.timeline.t9.text: He earned his degree; his early professional work began in Patni's software team.
